units.source_text: 黑鸦鸦的人影聚在小树丛的后面，正在移动着。

en.t: Dark silhouettes had gathered behind the small bushes and were moving about.

units.source_text: 身穿黑西服的有为子坐在地上。

en.t: Uiko, dressed in a black suit, was sitting on the ground.
Her face had gone deathly pale.

units.source_text: 她的周围围着四五个宪兵和她的双亲。

en.t: Four or five military police and her parents were gathered around her.

units.source_text: 其中一个宪兵拿出一个类似饭盒的小包，在大声申斥。

en.t: One of the military policemen took out a small parcel like a lunch box and was loudly reprimanding her.

units.source_text: 她父亲不停地转动着脑袋，时而向宪兵-一致歉，时而一个劲地斥责女儿。

en.t: Her father kept turning his head, now apologizing profusely to the military policemen, now furiously scolding his daughter.
Her mother crouched nearby, weeping bitterly.
